public_definitions: The goal is to assign January to the handling route that fits its position relative to the monthly average alert-day level.
The comparison scope is January's alert-day total against the monthly average level shown on the dashboard.
The supplied rules indicate using the monthly reported alert-day totals to determine the routing category.
